orders.instruction_en: At the Hallway door, threshold is about 18.2 cm, over the 3 cm reference: install a ramp at the threshold and keep the walker path clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊門口門檻高約18.2公分，超過3公分參考值：請於門檻處設置坡道，並保持助行器通道淨空。

orders.instruction_en: At the Hallway door, rug is off the walking path: secure the edges or remove it.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊門口地毯不在動線上：請固定邊緣或移除。

orders.instruction_en: At the Hallway door, cable covers 36% of the walking path: clear or relocate it and keep the path clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊門口電線有36%壓在行走動線上：請清除或移位，保持通道淨空。

orders.instruction_en: At the Hallway door, cable covers 19% of the walking path: clear or relocate it and keep the path clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊門口電線有19%壓在行走動線上：請清除或移位，保持通道淨空。

orders.instruction_en: In the Hallway to bathroom, cable covers 41% of the walking path: clear or relocate it and keep the path clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊至浴室通道電線有41%壓在行走動線上：請清除或移位，保持通道淨空。

orders.instruction_en: In the Hallway to bathroom, shoes cover 88% of the walking path: clear or relocate them and keep the path clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊至浴室通道鞋子有88%壓在行走動線上：請清除或移位，保持通道淨空。

orders.instruction_en: In the Hallway to bathroom, shoes cover 58% of the walking path: clear or relocate them and keep the path clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊至浴室通道鞋子有58%壓在行走動線上：請清除或移位，保持通道淨空。

orders.instruction_en: In the Hallway to bathroom, slippers cover 100% of the walking path: clear or relocate them and keep the path clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊至浴室通道拖鞋有100%壓在行走動線上：請清除或移位，保持通道淨空。

orders.instruction_en: In the Hallway to bathroom, slippers cover 100% of the walking path: clear or relocate them and keep the path clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 走廊至浴室通道拖鞋有100%壓在行走動線上：請清除或移位，保持通道淨空。

orders.instruction_en: In the Bathroom, floor is wet with ponding/slippery: apply anti-slip treatment and keep the floor dry and clear.
orders.instruction_zh: 浴室地面積水／濕滑：請進行防滑處理，並保持地面乾燥淨空。

orders.instruction_en: In the Bathroom, no grab bar detected beside the toilet: install a grab bar beside the toilet.
orders.instruction_zh: 浴室馬桶旁未偵測到扶手：請於馬桶旁加裝扶手。

summary_en: For a walker user, 11 records: Hallway door threshold about 18.2 cm needs a ramp; rug needs securing or removal; cables, shoes and slippers covering 19% to 100% of the walking path in Hallway door and Hallway to bathroom need clearing; Bathroom floor needs anti-slip treatment and a grab bar beside the toilet.
summary_zh: 助行器使用者共11筆紀錄：走廊門口門檻高約18.2公分需設坡道；地毯需固定或移除；走廊門口及走廊至浴室通道電線、鞋子、拖鞋有19%至100%壓在行走動線上需清除或移位；浴室地面濕滑需防滑處理，馬桶旁需加裝扶手。
